atlas.channels: single channel intensity (R=G=B in WebP). Upload as THREE.RedFormat, linear filter, no mipmaps v1
atlas.colorSpace: linear intensity, not sRGB color; tint in shader

conventions.pos: anchor pixel in source image space, origin top-left, x right, y down, units of `size` (Stellarium index.json)
conventions.atlas: same point in atlas pixels, origin top-left, y down
conventions.uv: three.js uv with flipY=true default: u = ax/4096, v = 1 - ay/4096
conventions.atlasRect: [x, y, w, h] in atlas pixels, origin top-left
conventions.uvRect: [u0, v0, u1, v1], v0 is the bottom edge (flipY=true)

look.shader: gl_FragColor = vec4(uTint * texture2D(uAtlas, vUv).r * uArtAlpha, 1.0); AdditiveBlending, depthWrite false, depthTest false
